== Template info ==

Hello. Thanks for all of your recent edits. I just wanted to bring up a few small things about the character template. If the character's last mention and last appearance are the same chapter, then only the last mention field is used in the template. Also, there isn't a parameter for "died" as you used it on Egwene's page. The "living" parameter is to break up the [[:Category:Living|living category]]. All of the [[:Category:Deceased|deceased]] fall into one category. See [[:Template:Character|the character template]] for descriptions of each parameter. Again, thanks for your recent edits and for joining up! Please let me know if you have any questions. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 22:37, February 20, 2013 (UTC)

== Literary present ==

While Wikipedia uses that, as well as a lot of other sites and written works, we don't. The reason is that we write our articles as if the subjects were real. As such, because they aren't "fiction," we use past tense on articles about characters that have died. See [[Wotwiki:OOC|this page]] for the information. Please let me know if you have any more questions. Thanks! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 13:48, April 24, 2013 (UTC)
